intro: Going on a trip? It’s time to think about what to take with you on the road! Many biohacking and medical devices can be extremely useful. Today, we will give you a travel items list to make even a long journey easier!
highlights: Smart travel gear helps stay healthy, focused, and energized on the road.
For train or plane travel, you may need a sleep mask, earplugs, compression socks and a neck pillow.
Don’t forget about skincare essentials and SPF.
To reduce jet lag, you can take supportive supplements.

blocks.text: Water Bottle

Taking a water bottle with you on the road is necessary to maintain water balance, prevent fatigue and headaches, ensure proper digestion, and for convenience and safety, as quality water is always at hand, especially on long trips, hikes, or in hot weather, when it can be difficult to replenish your supplies. This helps maintain energy and concentration, and also allows you to control the quality of the liquid, avoiding harmful impurities from poor-quality sources.
Sleep Mask

The fashion for sleep masks was introduced by Holly Golightly, the heroine of the romantic comedy Breakfast at Tiffany’s, played by Audrey Hepburn. The girl loved to sleep late, and this sleep aid became her most indispensable tool for getting a good night’s sleep. The mask protects the eyes from excess light: during daytime sleep, it is natural light; at night, it is street lights, turned-on screens, etc. Complete darkness speeds up the process of falling asleep and helps our brain tune in to a long, peaceful sleep. The mask enables you to fall asleep in places such as trains, planes, and hospitals, eliminating the need to react to sudden changes in lighting. Earplugs or Headphones

Earplugs are a great way to say goodbye to discomfort and unpleasant noise in your ears, even for young passengers. Headphones are an alternative. Choose between portable earbuds for convenience or full-size headphones for better sound/comfort on long trips. This way, you can work, listen to music, or watch a movie without distracting others or suffering from extraneous noise on the road.
Compression Socks

First-class compression hosiery can be chosen without a doctor’s prescription. This means that it is suitable for almost everyone, unless you have contraindications. Due to increased atmospheric pressure during flights and prolonged sitting, blood thickens and flows more slowly through the vessels. Plus, we spend almost all our time on the road, not moving, which only exacerbates the swelling. In this case, compression socks or stockings are our best ally. Stockings or knee-highs help prevent blood stagnation and swelling by distributing pressure evenly across the veins.
Travel Skincare Essentials

Long trips test your skin. Transport cabins, changing climates, new cuisines, and long days outdoors can leave your skin dehydrated or irritated. A well-packed skincare travel kit makes all the difference. With the right products, your skin stays clean, protected, and refreshed, no matter how far you go. Your travel facial care essentials should always include the basics. These products form the foundation of a routine that works anywhere: a cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen (SPF 30+), plus a lip balm, hydrating serum, and potentially facial wipes or micellar water for on-the-go freshening, to combat environmental stress like dry cabin air, sun, and new climates. Sun Protection

Sunscreens will help protect you from UV rays. They should be applied not only at the beach, but also when walking around town, hiking in the mountains, or in the forest. And in winter too, especially if you are going to ski resorts — UV radiation levels are higher in the mountains. Dermatologists recommend using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher to filter both UVA and UVB rays, even on a plane.
Caffeine

To fully enjoy every moment of your trip, it’s important to feel alert and energetic. This is where the faithful companion of many biohackers comes to the rescue — coffee. This aromatic drink can not only wake you up but also become an integral part of your trip, energizing you and infusing you with positivity.

[Caffeine](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-coffee), the main active ingredient in coffee, is a natural stimulant of the central nervous system. It blocks the action of adenosine, a neurotransmitter that contributes to fatigue. It stimulates the production of dopamine and norepinephrine, hormones that support alertness, attention, and improved mood. In addition, caffeine improves cognitive functions, including concentration and memory.
What’s more, coffee has mood-boosting properties. Caffeine stimulates the production of dopamine, a neurotransmitter associated with feelings of pleasure and motivation.
Electrolytes

Electrolytes control nerve and muscle function and maintain acid-base balance and hydration. Five of them play a key role in maintaining normal muscle function: sodium, potassium, magnesium, calcium, and chlorine. Consuming electrolytes during travel helps maintain hydration and electrolyte balance, especially on long flights when the risk of dehydration increases.
Orthopedic Insoles and Shoes

Take care of your feet in advance! It is better to wear orthopedic, comfortable shoes that will keep your feet as comfortable as possible. Heels and high platforms are not suitable. In summer, you can choose shoes made of soft textiles or natural leather, which allow air to pass through well. Choose modern “breathable” materials, comfortable orthopedic insoles, and slightly raised flexible soles. Your feet will not get hot or cold if the cabin air conditioning is turned on. Orthopedic insoles should be selected by a specialist.
Supplements to Support Jet Lag Recovery

To support [jet lag recovery](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-jet-lag-and-how-to-avoid-symptoms), supplements like melatonin (for sleep), magnesium (for relaxation), B vitamins (for energy/cycles), and electrolytes (for hydration) are key, alongside probiotics for gut health and herbs like L-Theanine or Ashwagandha for stress/sleep, helping reset your internal clock, energy, and overall wellness during travel.
Portable Neck Pillow

An orthopedic neck pillow will help relax the muscles in your neck and shoulder area. It is specially designed for comfort and anatomical support when traveling! The pillow ensures a comfortable position for your head and neck, eliminates discomfort, relaxes, and relieves tension and fatigue.

In today’s world, technology and portable devices have become indispensable companions for travelers, making every trip more comfortable and safe.
